description: This file defines the ContentTypeAuthorizationHandler class, which handles authorization logic for content types within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It manages permission checks based on content ownership and content type, utilizing dependency injection and async authorization calls.

classes.name: ContentTypeAuthorizationHandler
classes.description: A sealed class that extends AuthorizationHandler to provide custom authorization logic for content types based on permissions and ownership within OrchardCore.

methods.name: ContentTypeAuthorizationHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a service provider for dependency injection.

methods.name: HandleRequirementAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that handles authorization requirements by checking content ownership and permissions, and authorizing accordingly.

methods.name: GetOwnerVariation
methods.description: Static helper method to retrieve the owner variation of a given permission.

methods.name: HasOwnership
methods.description: Static helper method to determine if a user owns a specific content item.

methods.name: OwnerVariationExists
methods.description: Static helper method to check if an owner variation exists for a given permission.
